instruction.en: Pull the pin. Keep the nozzle pointed away from you.
instruction.id: Cabut pin pengaman. Jaga nozzle mengarah menjauhi tubuh.

instruction.en: Aim low, at the base of the fire.
Squeeze the lever slowly and evenly.
Sweep the nozzle from side to side.
instruction.id: Sapukan nozzle ke kiri dan kanan.
